text: 1，整体走势：市场全天震荡走强，三大指数均涨超1%，科创50指数涨近4%。个股涨多跌少，沪深京三市约3400股飘红，今日成交2.14万亿。截止收盘沪指涨1.13%，深成指涨1.5%，创业板指涨1.71%。 2，行业板块：算力硬件、半导体芯片、农业、消费电子等板块涨幅居前，银行、白酒、燃气、影视等板块跌幅居前。 3，热门概念：算力硬件股集体走强，金安国纪、宏昌电子、长飞光纤等多股涨停。半导体芯片股拉升，赛微电子、晶丰明源、昂瑞微均20cm涨停。农业股反复活跃，新赛股份、新农开发、万向德农等涨停。下跌方面，光伏设备板块下挫，阳光电源跌超12%。
text_en: 1, Overall trend: The market strengthened throughout the day, with all three major indices up over 1%, and the STAR 50 Index up nearly 4%. Gainers outnumbered decliners, with about 3,400 stocks rising across Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets; turnover reached 2.14 trillion yuan today. At close, the Shanghai Composite rose 1.13%, Shenzhen Component Index rose 1.5%, and ChiNext Index rose 1.71%. 2, Sectors: Computing hardware, semiconductor chips, agriculture, and consumer electronics led gains; banking, baijiu, gas, and film/TV fell. 3, Hot concepts: Computing hardware stocks rallied collectively, with Jin'an Guoji, Hongchang Electronics, and Yangtze Optical Fibre hitting limit-up. Semiconductor chip stocks surged, with Sai MicroElectronics, Bright Power Semiconductor, and Anywave each hitting 20cm limit-up. Agriculture stocks remained active, with Xinsai Co, Xinnong Development, and Wanxiang Denong hitting limit-up. On the downside, photovoltaic equipment fell, with Sungrow down over 12%.
